name: Angela Horwath
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Angela Horwath at Pacific Point Defense helps clients navigate the intricacies of the Washington legal system. A Seattle, Washington-based criminal defense attorney serving King, Pierce and Thurston counties, she safeguards your rights against arrest and arraignment. Her practice deals with drug offenses, assault, theft, DUI/DWI and domestic abuse. She provides advocacy that is specific to your legal circumstances while handling felony, misdemeanor and juvenile delinquency cases.

An established criminal defense lawyer, Ms. Horwath has led numerous complex cases, achieving successful results for her clients. Her reputation stems from a meticulous approach and a strong work ethic, ensuring thoroughness in every case. By blending effective legal strategies with genuine compassion, she alleviates the stress of the legal process. This dedication to excellence and advocacy drives the ongoing success of her practice.

Upon completing her undergraduate studies at Gonzaga University, Ms. Horwath received her Juris Doctor from Seattle University School of Law. She earned her licensure to practice law in Washington in 2006. Previously, as a public defender at the Department of Assigned Counsel, she served as lead counsel on numerous criminal cases. Her work drafting numerous legal motions and briefs, with an emphasis on domestic abuse cases, supports her commitment to client defense.

Throughout her career, Ms. Horwath’s mission has remained to provide exceptional representation and uphold the rights of individuals within the justice system. Driven by a deep passion for justice, she approaches every case with relentless dedication and personal integrity. She fiercely advocates for the marginalized, ensuring their voices are heard in the courtroom. This steadfast commitment to defense fuels her tireless work ethic and has allowed her to maintain a consistent “Superb” rating on Avvo.
